about: EOL fixtures, run by tools/ci/test-hygiene.ps1. listing: lines of `git ls-files --eol` (info, a tab, the path).

cases.name: clean-tree
cases.why: positive control: LF text, an empty file, a declared binary and a CRLF .cmd checkout

cases.name: crlf-in-index
cases.why: the repository stores LF only; a CRLF blob fails
match: ^tools/goldens/make_tiny\.py has crlf line endings in the index

cases.name: mixed-in-index
match: ^src/Lrm\.Tensor/Shape\.fs has mixed line endings in the index

cases.name: no-text-attribute
cases.why: .gitattributes must give every file a text attribute

cases.name: undeclared-binary
cases.why: binary content must be declared binary in .gitattributes
match: ^spikes/probes/bindtest/explicit\.dxbc holds binary content but \.gitattributes does not mark it binary; add a rule such as '\*\.dxbc binary'$

cases.name: crlf-checkout-only
cases.why: CRLF in the working tree alone is a warning, not an error
warn: ^spikes/probes/nfc\.fsx has crlf line endings in the working tree only
